text:
Marco: heads up — put together a short sync with HW partners next Wed 10am PT. goal: lock press windows and SKU phasing for H100/H200/B200 + MI300 + Gaudi. need firm embargo windows and any late-firmware risk flags. cc @Priya @Alex
Priya: noted. can we also ask partners for marketplace image readiness + SI onboarding ETA? those affect our beta cutover.
Alex: +1. specifically need: 1) firmware GA date, 2) driver packaging for our marketplace images, 3) SI test harness availability.
Jordan: is the ask for a hard cutover date or a rolling/stage approach? we should avoid a single big switch.
Marco: prefer staged: early access (limited sku) -> wide GA. want partner commitment on the early-access list by EOW.
Emily: quick flag — lab capacity for Gaudi run tests is tight the week of the 22nd. if partners want an early dry-run we need to reserve slots now.
Alex: can we propose two press windows? small partner announcement for early-access (week of 29th) and broader marketplace announce (mid-May). partners asked for a 2-week embargo buffer previously.
sre-bot: deployment-bot scheduled: "marketplace-image-scan" queued for 2026-04-27 02:00 UTC — will report back with missing deps.
Priya: also request partner confirmation on quantization/driver compatibility for B200 — we've seen perf regressions in internal tests. need mitigation plan.
Jordan: on SI side, we need SDK versioning pinned. SI integrators tell me they can't start until SDK 1.4 stable. is that a hard blocker?
Marco: yes — ask partners to either support SDK 1.4 or give a compatibility shim plan. if not, we push that SKU to phase 2.
Alex: Emily — can you send a lab reservation note with preferred windows? I'll include it in the partner invite.
Emily: sending in 5. prefer: 04/24-04/26 for Gaudi dry-run, 04/29-05/01 for MI300 soak.
Priya: drafting the invite now. agenda: timelines, embargo windows, firmware/driver ETA, marketplace image packaging, SI test harness, rollback/fallback policy.
Marco: perfect. last ask — partners sometimes want a single PR/press contact. can someone own press opt-in coordination? @Alex?
Alex: I can take press opt-in and embargo handoffs. will track with PR and Ops.
Jordan: allocating 2 SI engineers to the integration lane; will follow up with names in the invite.
Priya: invite out in 10m. action items captured in thread. thanks all :thumbsup:
